item.title: Hindu misia
item.description:
Source: TW

It seems many H are learning only recently that many among the mahAmlechCha hate them! Students of history would realize that this is just a SM surfacing of something very deep-rooted and going back deep in the nation’s history.

This, together with their legendary disunity, constantly puts them on the back foot with respect to questions like assimilation, “Western civilization,” and the operation of the Occident at large.
